summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, disclosing an at-the-market offering program. The company entered into a Market Issuance Sales Agreement with D. Boral Capital LLC to sell common shares with an aggregate offering price of up to $3,539,021. Sales will be made under an existing shelf registration statement on Form F-3. D. Boral will receive 2.0% of gross proceeds plus expense reimbursement. The filing is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation. No unusual terms or strategic events are present.
